newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - ADRs rise on data, Telebras up.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - ADRs rise on data, Telebras up.

text.p: Foreign companies' American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) and shares firmed overall Tuesday on mild U.S. inflation numbers.
"We're quite active across the board," a trader said. "I think that there was a deep sigh of relief today."
The U.S. government's Consumer Price Index for March rose less than expected, easing fears of a U.S. central bank interest rate hike to curb inflation.
Among Latin American ADRs, Brazilian telephone holding Telebras SA TEL.SA rose 1-3/8 to 111-5/8. Trade was moderate and Telebras was among the most active shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
Coca-Cola bottler Panamerican Beverages Inc of Mexico rose 1-1/4 to 28-3/8 on a Caracas newspaper report that a subsidiary had bought a 50-percent stake in Coca-Cola's Venezuelan bottling venture.
Canada's BioChem Pharma Inc fell 3-1/16 to 19-11/16. The shares were among the top 25 decliners on the Nasdaq exchange.
Canada's Delgratia Mining Corp DELGF.O rose 3-1/8 to 14-1/2 in heavy volume. The rise came after the company said four assay labs had verified test results on samples from its Nevada mining project.
Canada's Seagram Co Ltd rose 1/4 to 36-3/8 in heavy trade.
Advancers led decliners 305 to 122 among 806 ADRs. The ADR index was up 0.65 percent and volume in late morning was 26 million shares.
